name: Family Dinner
source:
It only takes one night to change everything.

Family Dinner is an interactive-fiction game about being a closeted transgender teenager at a family dinner, and all the awkwardness and upset that entails.

[From [url=https://pansandpots.itch.io/family-dinner]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
只需一个夜晚，一切就可能改变。

《Family Dinner》是一款互动小说游戏。你将以一名尚未出柜的跨性别青少年的身份参加家庭晚餐，经历由此而来的种种尴尬与难过。

[摘自[url=https://pansandpots.itch.io/family-dinner]itch.io[/url]]
